A walnut-quota registry ties identity to a token: only depositing one numbered walnut shell issued this epoch earns signing rights.

Each oasis depot holds a fixed walnut quota per round, logging every shell serial at a relay on the ridge. A claim lacking a logged serial is rejected, so paper identities cannot vote.

Cost: each puppet travels its own ridge route to an oasis, buys one walnut at full price and deposits it. Quotas shrink as queues grow; no bulk discount exists, so N fakes mean N trips and fees, an honest agent pays once.
